selection: random.Random(seed).sample over all candidate lines in source order
note: The TrOCR track's practice set is the kraken family-2 practice set, unchanged, so that kraken, Qwen-page and TrOCR numbers on these lines are comparable. BLB train side only (lassberg, korrespondenten, unbestimmt, manuskripte; never *_eval). Objects are disjoint from data/heldout/blb-eval-hand (see overlap-trocr-blb-train-300.json). 7 of the 300 crops are taller than wide and 7 references have 1-3 characters (rules that blb-eval-hand excludes); they are kept, as in every earlier use of this list.
seen_by_note: same 300 lines as trocr-blb-train-300 plus seen_by=[] on every line: no model of the TrOCR family is recorded as trained on them. Audited for from-kurrent-v2 against its 20 datasets (docs/trocr/audit_trained_overlap.json); NOT audited for the parents' corpora (kurrent 293 k lines, XVI-XVII 1.58 M words): an assumption until the model authors answer (docs/trocr/STAGE0.md section 8, item 4).
